Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util

Class BucketState

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.BucketState
public final class BucketState extends Object
Serializes, deserializes, and normalizes the persistent state of all bucket families. Every payload lives in a registered data component from ModDataComponentTypes; runtime bucket behavior reads and writes that state through this class. Mutators edit the supplied stack in place, leave canonical empty state behind (an exhausted payload's component removed), and never touch unrelated components.

    • drainFiniteContent

      public static int drainFiniteContent(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, int requestedAmount)
      Removes up to requestedAmount millibuckets from fluid or milk mode. Removing the final amount clears the content payload while preserving stored-item state.
      Parameters:
      stack - bucket stack to mutate in place
      requestedAmount - millibuckets to remove; a nonpositive value is a no-op
      Returns:
      the amount actually removed in millibuckets; zero for any other mode or a nonpositive request, with no mutation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a milk request would leave a partial bucket of milk

    • getStoredItemsComponent

      @Nullable public static ModDataComponentTypes.JunkContents getStoredItemsComponent(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack container)
      Returns the raw stored-junk component for change detection by client render caches. Bucket state writers replace the component wholesale on every edit, so its object identity changes when the stored items or layout seed change. The returned component exposes mutable item stacks and must be treated as read-only.
      Parameters:
      container - storage-bucket stack to inspect
      Returns:
      the current ModDataComponentTypes.JunkContents, or null when no junk items are stored
